title: security(explain): /security/explain reports decidedBy "sharing" ("0 share(s) attached; access is granted") for a read granted by read depth
body:
QA-source: #21720 · access-security.sharing-rules-widen · outside the item's clauses

Seen by lane L1 of the 17.7 pre-release run #21720 (subject `251a7dd4`); verifier V3 reproduced it on two fresh boots: CONFIRMED, P3 (diagnostic only — it grants nothing extra).

## Reproduction

1. Admin mints a member U (invite + sign-up) and `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position {"user_id":U,"position":"manager"}`.
2. Admin `POST /api/v1/security/explain {"object":"showcase_contact","operation":"read","userId":U,"recordId":"{id of a contact with no share row, e.g. Noah Bell}"}`.
3. Actual: `record: {visible:true, decidedBy:"sharing"}`; the depth layer says it widens ("Effective read depth: 'org'") but carries no `record` block; the sharing layer says admitted with "0 share(s) attached; access is granted for this record." U's own `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_contact/{id}` → 200, so the access is real and comes from depth.
4. Contrast: a contact that matches a criteria rule shows "1 share(s) attached".

Expected `decidedBy: "depth"` — a member of the published enum (`packages/spec/src/security/explain.zod.ts:331-341`).

## Mechanism

`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts`: `sharingOutcome = 'admitted'` whenever `sharingMatches === true` (:1353), which comes from the sharing read filter that already includes the org depth; the decision tree at :1484-1497 then picks `'sharing'` and no branch ever produces `'depth'`; the detail string at :1387 prints "N share(s)… granted" without checking that a share granted anything.
